_comment: The reviewer App's permission set, declared once. bootstrap.py builds a new
App's manifest from it, and mint-token.sh audits every minted token against
it — so a grant that drifts is caught on the next review rather than at the
next time somebody remembers to run a curl by hand.
`expected` is exact, not a floor. A permission missing from an install breaks
a capability; one present that is not listed here is a capability the design
says the bot must not have, and both are worth a warning.

why.pull_requests: submit reviews, inline comments, thread replies
why.contents: read the diff; resolve threads; have the verdict counted
why.statuses: combined commit status, for CI that posts statuses instead of check runs

deliberately_absent.issues: the issue-scoped mode runs under the operator's own auth, so the bot has no reason to reach issues at all
